## Wave 2 Summary

Four NON-AUTHOR Stage-2 cross-axis PASS-AND verifies of the four STAGE-1-CANDIDATE §VII theorems S111 landed (§VII.CG / §VII.CH / §VII.CI / §VII.CJ). Each gate's "computation" is the two-agent parallel cross-axis independent verify of `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"`: two NON-AUTHOR reviewers on DISTINCT axes, dispatched IN PARALLEL, operating WITHOUT prior workshop context (they read ONLY the registered Stage-1 entry text + the cited input artifacts — never the originating workshop transcript), with the JOINT clause(s) PASS-AND'd (logical AND, not OR) across both verdicts. A gate PASSes iff BOTH reviewers PASS each of their single-axis clauses AND every JOINT clause PASSes independently in BOTH verdicts; ANY clause FAIL leaves the theorem at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; either reviewer INFO on a clause leaves it at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE with the clause documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item.

This is a **PARALLEL-COMPUTE wave** (Q3 per `Investigating-Workshops.md §"Q3"`): four INDEPENDENT gates, each producing its OWN PASS-AND verdict on its OWN pair of structurally-orthogonal axes, NOT an adversarial N-agent panel. There is no R1/R2/R3 round protocol because the per-gate axes are structurally orthogonal — Axis-A's reviewer cannot meaningfully rebut Axis-B's verdict on a different axis. The per-gate "two cross-reviewers" are derivation-VERIFIER tags (which agent audits which axis's clauses), not workshop-participant tags. The four gates have no cross-gate dependency and may run fully in parallel.

Carry-forward source: `session-111-housekeeping.md §B` (the four Stage-2 verifies, mirrors of the per-wave WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` blocks: w1 WP 446/455, w3 WP 260, w5 WP 359). On PASS each gate flips its §VII slot STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT; the registry tag-flip is applied by `mack-cosmic-bridge` (registry sole-writer per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`), NOT by the verify gate itself — the gate emits the PASS verdict line + a WP section recording the cross-axis PASS-AND; the tag-flip is an orchestrator-direct mack pass keyed off the verdict.

### Reviewer-selection guard (the LOAD-BEARING Stage-2 audit, applies to all four gates)

Per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage-2 Axis-B Selection Protocol"` + §"Audit at plan-freeze" items (1)–(6), each gate's two reviewers MUST satisfy ALL of:
1. **Dispatched IN PARALLEL** (one Agent message, two tool calls) — not sequential.
2. **Axis-distinct** — primary methodologies on genuinely different axes (not two same-axis reviewers with narrow-specialty difference).
3. **Original-author-excluded + downstream-inheritance reach** — neither reviewer is a Stage-0 workshop author of THIS theorem, nor a successor whose project-memory cites the originating workshop transcript as canonical.
4. **No workshop transcript in the dispatch prompt** — reviewers receive ONLY the registered Stage-1 entry text + the cited input artifacts (npz, anchor gates), and verify from first principles.
5. **JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd** across both verdicts in the gate logic (logical AND).
6. **No self-authored verdict-machinery** — if a reviewer applies a parse-tree / 4-corner / cohomology-bridge decision procedure at the verdict layer, that machinery must not be sole-authored by that same reviewer (else an alternate route or a second cross-check applies). For these four gates the verdict machinery is the registered-clause PASS-AND, authored by the orchestrator/plan, not by either reviewer ⇒ clause 6 satisfied by construction.

The reviewer pairs selected below are reconciled against each registered entry's OWN closing-paragraph candidate list (the Stage-0 authors' intended Axis-A/Axis-B suggestions), filtered for the exclusions.

PASS_meaning: >
  Both NON-AUTHOR reviewers independently PASS their single-axis clauses (einstein: (a); transit-dynamics: (b)) AND the JOINT layer-obstruction no-go clause (c) PASSes in BOTH verdicts. Stage-2 is structurally-independent verification (neither reviewer read the WS-CLOCKLOC workshop). §VII.CG promotes STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (mack applies the registry tag-flip). The dual-prior resolves: the JOINT-(c) PASS-AND on the layer-type no-go is the structural-ROOT reading (the 5 VdD-Hawking arguments PRESUPPOSE the layer separation) — Track-B mass dominates. Solution-space: the exflation≠inflation distinction (transit of a Level-2 deformation parameter, not slow-roll of a Level-1 field) is now a permanent structural theorem, not a single-axis candidate.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Either reviewer returns FAIL on ANY clause (a)/(b)/(c). Stage-2 → Stage-3 promotion is BLOCKED; §VII.CG stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause routes to next-session remediation. Solution-space: the layer-type no-go is not yet independently confirmed on the FAILing axis — the corridor (r=16ε has no substrate image) remains a single-axis-authored candidate, not a wall.
INFO_meaning: >
  Either reviewer returns INFO on a clause (e.g., the dual-prior adjudication splits — one reviewer reads structural-ROOT, the other 6th-INDEPENDENT, without a clause FAIL). §VII.CG stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` INFO criterion. NOT a FAIL — the theorem's clauses PASS but the dual-prior track-allocation is unresolved.

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: A-placement clause [Axis-A spectral] = a new relic mode from an L_max>=12 extension carries higher Casimir C_2(p,q) ⇒ higher A=ω² ⇒ lands near zone n=round(√A)>=3 (low-n zones SATURATED; npz: A>9 ⇒ nearest_n ∈ {3,4}); SINGLE-AXIS Axis-A (connes-ncg-theorist).
    Definition 2: EXPONENT+no-overlap clause [Axis-B transport/band-stability] = Δa_½^{(n)} ∝ q^n leading power EXACTLY n (DLMF-28.6 exact: degree_q==n, convention-INDEPENDENT) AND no-overlap certificate (worst-case A=9.000371 prefactor-correct half-width q³/64=1.628e-09 ≪ detuning 3.712e-04; 0-of-1248 modes overlap ⇒ |Tr M|<2 every mode); SINGLE-AXIS Axis-B (landau).
    Definition 3: JOINT EXPONENT = the EXPONENT n is the registered structural claim (D_K Casimir ladder → A near zone n → q^n half-width ⇒ §VII.BP DEAD at any L_max>=12); the ×16 and all coefficient prefactors are DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY, convention-ambiguous, NOT registered; PASS-AND'd across BOTH reviewers.
    Substitute:  composite_PASS = (A.casimir_A_placement ∧ B.exponent_and_nooverlap) ∧ (A.joint_exponent ∧ B.joint_exponent)
    Simplify:    the EXPONENT-n is the JOINT clause both reviewers must independently PASS (the convention-independent order-of-vanishing claim); the A-placement is the spectral input (where new modes land) and the no-overlap is the band-stability output (the tongues are too narrow to overlap detuning) — the two single-axis clauses are the two halves of the cutoff-robustness argument (mode-density vs half-width concentration). No coverage gap: connes covers the D_K Casimir-ladder spectral placement, landau covers the Mathieu-tongue monodromy band-stability. Mnemonic-vs-exact: the bare (q_M)^{n>=3}<=1e-7 plan mnemonic is LOOSE at the broad-band-max q_M=5.248e-03 ((q_M)³=1.445e-07>1e-7), the prefactor-correct half-width q³/64=2.258e-09<=1e-7 is load-bearing (math-scripts.md §"Mnemonic-vs-exact"); the EXPONENT (registered) is unaffected.
    Canonical form: composite = AND over {A.casimir_A_placement, B.exponent_and_nooverlap, A.joint_exponent, B.joint_exponent}.
    Direction:   composite TRUE ⇒ Stage-2 PASS ⇒ §VII.CJ STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (a 4th orthogonal pin of §VII.BP DEAD — cutoff-robustness); ANY clause FALSE ⇒ stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE.
    Conclusion:  the gate PASSes iff the spectral A-placement PASSes on Axis-A AND the EXPONENT-n + no-overlap certificate PASSes on Axis-B AND the JOINT EXPONENT-n claim PASSes in BOTH verdicts. The §VII.BP DEAD verdict is CONFIRMED (not re-gated) — a registration PASS strengthens the evidence by closing the L_max-extension loophole structurally.

PASS_meaning: >
  Both NON-AUTHOR reviewers independently PASS: connes PASSes the D_K Casimir-ladder A-placement (new modes land
  in high-n zones), landau PASSes the EXPONENT-n + no-overlap band-stability certificate, and the JOINT EXPONENT-n
  claim PASSes in BOTH verdicts. §VII.CJ promotes STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (mack applies the tag-flip).
  Solution-space: §VII.BP H-PARITY-DRIVE-EXCLUSION DEAD acquires a 4th ORTHOGONAL pin (cutoff-robustness) — no
  L_max>=12 truncation refinement can admit a re-pumping mode, by the geometry of the Mathieu tongue exponents +
  the D_K Casimir ladder, NOT by a lucky numerical margin. The Ordered Veil (S_ent=0, R_therm=5251.82) is protected
  against truncation refinement structurally.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Either reviewer returns FAIL on its assigned clause or on the JOINT EXPONENT-n claim (e.g., the EXPONENT is found
  convention-dependent, or a relic mode is found to overlap its detuning). Stage-2 → Stage-3 is BLOCKED; §VII.CJ
  stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause routes to remediation. Solution-space: the cutoff-robustness pin is
  not yet independently confirmed; §VII.BP DEAD retains its three prior pins (the FAIL does NOT re-open §VII.BP — it
  only withholds the 4th confirmatory pin).
INFO_meaning: >
  Either reviewer returns INFO on a clause (e.g., a reviewer flags the mnemonic-vs-exact prefactor disclosure as
  needing a tighter statement, or reads the no-overlap margin as adequate-but-not-decisive at the worst-case mode,
  without a FAIL). §VII.CJ stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item.
  NOT a FAIL — the EXPONENT claim PASSes but a diagnostic-side reading is flagged.

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 3 (CF-S112-B5A-BRACKETED + CF-S112-FLOQUET3-HPAR-TIGHTEN, owner hawking/transit-dynamics) does NOT consume any Wave 2 output — the four Stage-2 verifies are registry-completion gates with no downstream compute dependency on the B5A microstate or FLOQUET3 h_par gates. Wave 2 and Wave 3 may run in parallel.

Post-Wave-2 registry actions (orchestrator-direct, keyed off the verdict lines; NOT Wave-2 gate outputs):
- **For each gate that PASSes**: `mack-cosmic-bridge` flips the corresponding §VII slot STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT in `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` (registry sole-writer per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`), citing the gate's PASS verdict audit_sha256. Update the knowledge MCP entry status.
- **§VII.CI PASS additionally**: `mack-cosmic-bridge` applies the categorical upgrade to atlas-04 N7, §VII.W-3.SUBSTRATE (c) verdict-name, and atlas-08 Q10/Q9 (obstructed-on-two-decidable-axes → categorically-obstructed-for-all-bridge-maps), per the §VII.CI PASS_meaning.
- **§VII.CG PASS additionally**: the 6th-INDEPENDENT-vs-structural-ROOT dual-prior resolves to structural-ROOT (Track-B); record in the §VII.CG entry annotation + the capstone §6.3 exflation≠inflation narration (capstone designated-writer per `capstone-hygiene-gate.md` Q3).
- **For any gate that FAILs/INFOs**: the §VII slot stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing/INFO clause routes to next-session remediation as a 4-field carry-forward (per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` FAIL/INFO criterion). No registry tag-flip.

**Reviewer-non-collision cross-check** (no agent both authors and reviews the same theorem):
- CG: reviewers {einstein, transit-dynamics} ∩ authors {schwarzschild-penrose, hawking} = ∅ ✓
- CH: reviewers {connes, volovik} ∩ authors {einstein, loop-quantum-gravity} = ∅ ✓
- CI: reviewers {lizzi, kaluza-klein} ∩ authors {connes, van-den-dungen} = ∅ ✓

**Cross-gate reviewer reuse is admissible** (connes reviews both CH-AxisA and CJ-AxisA; transit-dynamics reviews CG-AxisB) — the exclusion is per-theorem (an agent may not review a theorem it authored), NOT per-session; connes did not author CH or CJ, transit-dynamics did not author CG. Each gate's pair is independently axis-distinct and author-excluded.
